2014_spells.danse-macabre.effectSummary: Move a creature or object a short distance
2014_spells.danse-macabre.fullDescriptio: Using 1 action, you decide whether it is a zombie or a skeleton (the statistics for zombies and skeletons are in the Monster Manual), and it gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to your spellcasting ability modifier. To receive the command, a creature must be within 60 feet of you; You can use a bonus action to mentally command the creatures you make with this spell, issuing the same command to all of them. You decide the creature's action and movement on its turn, and you can also issue a general command, such as to guard a chamber or corridor until you give the spell new orders; you must concentrate, and the effect ends if your concentration ends.
